title: •Trooper Davin Felth
caption: •Trooper Davin Felth (V)
game_text: During your control phase, may ▲ (or lose 1 Force to retrieve) one Local Trouble or Look Sir, Droids. Opponent may not fire weapons during Local Trouble battles.
lore: Dispatched to Tatooine to apprehend renegade droids fleeing the _Tantive IV_. Suspected to have misgivings about Imperial methods. Allegedly shot his commander in the back.
